sections.skill: Compare selling channels by fees, reach and contribution

questions.prompt: What is wholesale?

choices.text: Selling one item at full price online to a shopper
Selling in bulk at a lower price to stores that resell

questions.correct_answer: Selling in bulk at a lower price to stores that resell
questions.intro: A product can be sold through different CHANNELS: your own website, an online marketplace, local markets and fairs, wholesale to shops, or consignment. Each has different fees, reach and control. A marketplace may bring buyers but charges fees and sets rules; your own site gives control but you must bring the visitors; WHOLESALE sells in bulk at a lower price (often around half of retail) to stores that resell. Compare contribution per sale after channel costs.

questions.prompt: 15 percent of 30 is what?
questions.intro: For each channel, contribution = price - product cost - channel fees. Fees may be a percent (marketplace commission) or a fixed amount (booth fee per item). Example: price 30, cost 12, marketplace fee 15 percent (4.50): 30 - 12 - 4.50 = 13.50. Wholesale at 15 with cost 12: 3 dollars per unit but many units at once. Multiply by units to compare totals.
